payload.description: Data items recall is 43/140 (30.7%) on develop; baseline was 38/140 (27.1%). The +5 came from Ruby ingestion side effects, not data-items detector work. Target the data-items detector to improve recall toward 60+/140 without cratering precision, other layers unchanged. Investigate why the data-items detector misses ~97 of 140 gold positives. Do not change gold. Measure against pinned baseline.
payload.title: Improve data-items detector recall (38/140 -> 60+)
